about: The rows of the status tables in docs/status.md: each table's heading, gate target and default run; each row's area, the targets whose tables show it, and the gate results its Runtime and Memory cells show, by the directory each lies in (in a gate run, the item whose timing, memory and grade share it), from the runs it names or else its table's; or a text for both cells of a row with no measurement of its own. A run is the evidence set named so, or the sets named so followed by -shard-N. `cargo xtask check-design` renders the cells from the results' measured records and fails on any difference; `cargo xtask status` prints or writes them. open_cells lists the rows whose cells stay as written until `cargo xtask evidence measure` records what their results measured; it only shrinks.

parity.aarch64-unknown-linux-gnu: All twelve cases match picture bytes, picture times and presented PCM counts, with PCM within 1 LSB. Three also match every packet field. The ASS overlay matches all 17 images and both frame records, including expiry.

62 of 150 cases match, with 87 declared deviations (83 of them recovery policy) and 1 open case. The [control-event oracle](../harness/features/facade-mpegts-controls/contract.json) matches 10 TS188 and M2TS192 cases for carriers, PSI, PES, clock and continuity loss, interrupted data, header-only video and unsupported framing.

8/8 MPEG-TS, 96/252 Matroska and 31/33 ISO BMFF seeks match. Every delivered packet is compared, and the other 158 differ exactly as [container-pins.json](../harness/features/facade-seek/container-pins.json) pins them: 92 declared clock deviations, 50 seek policy differences and 16 open cases. The Matroska comparison verifies delivered preroll against sequential source packets. The [source lifecycle oracle](../harness/features/facade-source-control/contract.json) verifies capabilities, reset and input failure in all four container cases.

417/417 comparable conformance and FATE vectors; three crafted AAC Parametric Stereo streams covering paths absent from FATE (a 20/34-band change registered while PS is off, IPD/OPD across a change, a PS frame without its SBR element); the audio correctness check `codecs-audio` at `4b87991e` on both targets, using the 71 derived streams reproduced byte for byte by `cargo xtask codecs derive`: AAC 39/39, AC-3 6/6, E-AC-3 6/6, DTS core 22/22, and `xll_51_24_48_none` out of set (no core substream) The video grades retain 36 registered refusals with pinned inputs, diagnostics and picture counts.

On AArch64, `codecs-files` compares the 333 file vectors. Four format-changing files match on native PCM and stereo output across all format segments. The comparison grades decoded PCM and stereo device output under the [numeric rules](../harness/codecs/numeric-rules.json). All 54 Opus cases match, including two pre-skip cases spanning multiple packets. The separate AAC-in-MOV grade matches on all three vectors. For the ten timed files, 10/10 pass both FFmpeg grades and 10/10 match main (`838a07a5`) byte for byte on stereo s16 at `a875b007`. The [integer PCM comparison](../harness/features/flac-integer/contract.json) passes 30/30 on AArch64, including the coded low bits of 32-bit PCM, a bare format change, and the default, Ignore and Reject CRC policies.
